prompt:

Produce one very high-resolution wide 2:1 catalog triptych, exactly THREE EQUAL WIDTH vertical panels, each 2:3 aspect. Left panel full straight FRONT flatlay, middle full straight BACK flatlay of EXACT SAME garment, right panel macro construction detail of the front. Neutral warm light-grey matte background #E8E7E1 across all panels. Neutral daylight, textile tactile realism, overhead camera, subtle natural shadow only, exact coherent patterns and materials. Garments centered and entire silhouette contained in each left/middle panel with 10% breathing room, no overlap between panels. No text, labels, logos, numbers, rulers, hands, models, decorations, watermarks. Button counts and pockets must be EXACT. No additional seams or trims. Colour uniform across ALL views. This is locked source art direction for Collection 01: Everyday Structure.
PLEAT TROUSER in Ink (near-black green #161A18), 65% cotton35% linen twill, full length broad straight legs, exactly ONE forward pleat per leg (TWO total), two side-entry pockets ONLY, fixed waistband with ONE centered dark closure button and concealed fly, five belt loops total. M laid-flat waistband half-width40cm, inseam76cm. Straight hems without turn-ups. Back has plain seat with NO BACK POCKETS, one center-back seam, normal side/inner leg seams.
